summary: Implemented the Lambda transform feature in the MONAI repo. Added Lambda(func) to monai/transforms/utility/array.py and Lambdad(keys, func) to monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py. Lambdad accepts one callable for all keys or one callable per key, and both raise TypeError for non-callables. Added Lambda and Lambdad entries to docs/source/transforms.rst, and new tests in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was committed, the CHANGELOG was not updated, and the tests were not run because repository code execution was ruled out by the task constraints, so they are unverified.
